items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: he could never say Wilbert, so he just said, well, I'll call you Bird. And he started to call me Bird

ctx.x: That's, uh, he could never say Wilbert, so he just said, well, I'll call you Bird. And he started to call me Bird, and from then on everybody started calling me Bird. Mm-hmm. That was a Filipino boy, originally, was young. Mm-hmm.
He was trying to say Wilbert and now he could come out with the Bird?
